skill.name: detect-ai
skill.description: Use HumanizerAI to evaluate text for AI-written patterns and return a 0-100 score, verdict, metrics, and recommendation.

skill.author: humanizerai

security_audit.summary: The Markdown backtick findings are false positives from code spans and fences. The real risks are third-party content transmission and handling a HumanizerAI API key.

remediation.issue: User text is sent to an external API.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users before analysis that their text will be sent to HumanizerAI, and advise against submitting sensitive content.

remediation.issue: The skill uses HUMANIZERAI_API_KEY for authentication.
remediation.suggestion: State that the key should be a dedicated HumanizerAI key, never print it, and only send it to the documented endpoint.

remediation.issue: API failure guidance may expose setup details.
remediation.suggestion: Report only whether the key is configured, and never include the key value or environment dumps in errors.

content.user_title: Check Text for AI Writing Signals
content.value_statement: Teams need a fast way to review writing before publication or submission. This skill sends text to HumanizerAI and returns a clear AI-likelihood score.
actual_capabilities: Submits provided text to the HumanizerAI detection API.
Reports the overall AI score from the API response.
Shows word count, verdict, and supporting detection metrics.
Interprets score ranges from human-written to highly AI-generated.
Suggests a next step based on the returned score.
limitations: Requires a configured HumanizerAI API key.
Sends submitted text to an external service for analysis.
Results depend on the HumanizerAI API and its current model.
Does not prove authorship or detect plagiarism.

use_cases.title: Review Blog Drafts
use_cases.description: Check article drafts for AI-writing signals before editorial review.

use_cases.title: Screen Student Submissions
use_cases.description: Get a detection score and metrics before deciding whether more review is needed.

use_cases.title: Validate Client Copy
use_cases.description: Run a quick check on supplied marketing copy before publishing it.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Short Passage
prompt_templates.prompt: Use detect-ai to analyze this paragraph and explain the score in plain language: [paste text]

prompt_templates.title: Review a Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Use detect-ai to check this draft. Include the overall score, verdict, key metrics, and a brief recommendation: [paste draft]

prompt_templates.title: Compare Revision Risk
prompt_templates.prompt: Use detect-ai on this revised copy. Tell me whether it still shows strong AI-writing signals: [paste revised copy]

prompt_templates.title: Audit Multiple Sections
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of a structured document.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use detect-ai for each labeled section below. Summarize which sections need human editing and why: [paste labeled sections]

output_examples.input: A 600-word article draft for a company blog.
output_examples.output: AI Detection Results: Score 82 out of 100. Verdict: likely AI-generated. The text should be revised for more natural variation.
AI Detection Results: Score 27 out of 100. Verdict: likely human-written. Minor AI-like patterns are present, so use normal review.
Section A shows low AI signals. Section B is mixed. Section C has high AI signals and needs the most editing.

best_practices: Review the score with the detailed metrics before making a decision.
Avoid submitting confidential, regulated, or private text unless approved.
Use results as a screening signal, not as final proof of authorship.
anti_patterns: Do not treat a high score as automatic misconduct evidence.
Do not paste secrets, private records, or unreleased business plans.
Do not ignore API errors or missing key messages.

faq.question: What does this skill analyze?
faq.answer: It analyzes submitted text for AI-writing signals using the HumanizerAI detection API.

faq.question: Does it work without an API key?
faq.answer: No. It requires HUMANIZERAI_API_KEY to authenticate with HumanizerAI.

faq.question: Will my text leave my environment?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill sends submitted text to HumanizerAI for analysis.

faq.question: What score should I focus on?
faq.answer: Use the overall score from the response. Higher scores mean stronger AI-writing signals.

faq.question: Can this prove who wrote the text?
faq.answer: No. It provides a detection signal, not proof of authorship.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
